title: What We Wrote Down
text: Before you come down: we keep notes. By our count you have been kind to us, more often than you needed to be. We have it all written down. It is a short list, and we like it.
notes: Says the engram counter aloud before engram-choice reads it (v0.91.0): ≥ 3 kind, 1–2 careful, ≤ 0 hard.
